why: Proposal A delivers almost every piece the client named in a calm Japandi palette: a clean-lined beige sofa, a jute rug, a low round wood table and a rice-paper lantern lamp. Its only miss is the plastic nursery pot instead of ceramic. Proposal B leans boho, with a patterned rug too small for the room, an ornate carved drum table and a puffy, pillow-heavy sofa, and has no paper lantern, which goes against the serene, pared-back look requested.
